newsitem.title: USA: MGM Grand sees two charges in Q3.
newsitem.headline: MGM Grand sees two charges in Q3.

text.p: MGM Grand Inc Thursday said it expects to take two charges totaling $22.1 million in the third quarter to account for construction at its flagship MGM Grand hotel in Las Vegas and a new credit facility.

In a teleconference, President Alex Yemenidjian said the first charge will total $17.9 million after taxes. It results from theme park and pool area changes associated with its previously announced $700 million expansion at the MGM Grand.
In addition, the company will take an after tax charge of $4.2 million to account for changes in its credit line after Wednesday's announcement of the $2.0 billion credit facility.
